findings.finding: Science and controls resided in campaign packets with private paths, old seals and historical datasets.
findings.resolution: Preserve complete selected arguments as20canonical bounded-model notes,34new discoverable helper sources, fresh isolated runners and full stdout/generatedJSON. Reuse five unchanged canonical helpers. Keep exhaustive original-path recovery and preserve deferred branches.

findings.finding: The general compensation note called every displayed operator self-adjoint.
findings.resolution: Apply its original correction: only H2C and H4C are self-adjoint. Raw graph-coordinate coefficients and formation maps need not be. Independent noncommuting matrices verify the canonical correction.

findings.finding: Original prose could admit arbitrary physical inputs, presume cyclic terminal-sector existence, or suggest simultaneous shrinking event windows.
findings.resolution: Apply all supplied scope corrections: P-supported convergent inputs; compatible fully occupied Gauss sector, componentwise even B count; fixed positive event window before microscopic limit and only then shrinking. Exact ideal two-jump phase is distinguished from finite-window propagation.

findings.finding: Uniform-in-lambda supply/clock conclusions used a substantive Duhamel proof in an old reconstruction packet.
findings.resolution: Retain and attribute that mathematical section in the canonical electric-star note, with notation and common preparation explicit. Historical packet status and seals confer no authority.

findings.finding: Some author controls only printed final symbolic flux/H4 coefficients, and the exponential matrix sweep omitted absolute weights.
findings.resolution: Assert all-mark spin polynomials, exact H4 moments and drift, covariance and full selected image count. Add clipped/unclipped absolute weights to the finite weighted-generator check. Independent tensor and complex-matrix controls agree.

findings.finding: An intentionally shortened battery buffer passed original loose norm bounds despite violating the promised exact buffered-input operation.
findings.resolution: Add exact translated-unitary equality on every buffered basis column, including boundary coordinates. Re-run only the affected battery wrapper and mutation; the correct implementation passes and the shortened buffer now fails a mathematical assertion. Original failed sensitivity result is retained.
